verdict.rationale: Factory's docs directly state that Droid exec uses tiered autonomy to control which operations can run without manual confirmation, and the CLI overview separately mentions approvals in the interactive runtime. The documentation is a single summary-level statement, with no specifics on the levels or how they are configured. Missing for 10: names and definitions of each autonomy tier, evidence of team/org-level enforcement by a lead (beyond per-invocation settings), explicit coverage outside droid exec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can set tiered autonomy levels controlling what an agent can do without manual confirmation

citations.quote: Droid exec uses tiered autonomy to control what operations can run without manual confirmation.
It gives the same Factory runtime through an interactive terminal UI with project context, approvals, MCP tools, Missions, and headless execution.
